To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) LCC = AC + LSC, (2) LSC = LCC - AC, and (3) LCC = f(R) = AC + LCC, where LCC is the life cycle cost, AC is the acquisition cost, LSC is the logistics support cost, and f(R) is the life cycle function vs reliability.
LSC is the sum of the following five functions of reliability: (1) preventive maintenance, (2) spare parts, (3) repair, (4) transportation, and (5) personnel.
LCC = AC+LSC = (1+LSC/AC) AC = (1+R) AC, where AC = acquisition cost, LSC = logistics support cost, and R = reliability function.
